name: DeVRF
aliases: DeVRF — A method that designs a static-dynamic learning paradigm to simplify learning 4D voxel deformation fields using only a few dynamic sequences.
definition: A method that designs a static-dynamic learning paradigm to simplify learning 4D voxel deformation fields using only a few dynamic sequences.
summary: DeVRF simplifies learning 4D voxel deformation fields for dynamic scenes by combining a static voxel grid with a deformation field, enabling faster convergence than fully implicit networks.
